locations.note: The prologue follows Alfie at Morris & Banks before he leaves for Florida.
Miami scenes include Flagler Street, the Miami Herald and the Miami Men's Club.
Alfie works in Coral Gables during its real estate boom, around the sales office, the Bank of Coral Gables and the Merrick House.
A chapter takes Alfie to Havana, where he investigates a bar and an office.
Alfie follows the Tamiami Trail into the Everglades, where he finds a distillery at a hut.
The Biltmore is the location the story returns to most, with a 13th-floor suite and a secret room.
William Jennings Bryan speaks at the Venetian Pool.

routes.name: Alfie's journey
routes.note: Alfie Banks leaves New York for Miami, sells land in Coral Gables, takes a trip to Havana and ends up on the Tamiami Trail in 1929.
